items.exampleEn: Although the food was cheap, it was very good.
items.exampleZh: 雖然食物很便宜，但是非常好吃。

items.exampleEn: He looks young, but he is actually fifty.
items.exampleZh: 他看起來很年輕，但其實已經五十歲了。

items.exampleEn: She will probably be late again.
Perhaps we can meet next week.
items.exampleZh: 也許我們下週可以見個面。

items.exampleEn: The children cleaned the room themselves.
items.exampleZh: 孩子們自己把房間打掃乾淨了。

items.sentenceEn: There is a small cafe across the street.
items.sentenceZh: 街道對面有一家小咖啡店。

items.audioEn: Although it was cold, the kids played outside all afternoon.
items.audioZh: 雖然天氣很冷，孩子們整個下午都在外面玩。

items.sentenceEn: Perhaps it will be sunny tomorrow.

items.stemEn: Look! A big dog is running ____ us.
items.stemZh: 你看！一隻大狗正朝我們跑過來。

items.stemEn: ____ he was tired, he still finished his homework.
items.stemZh: 雖然他很累，還是把功課寫完了。

items.passageEn: Lisa and Kevin wanted to try the new restaurant across the river. Although it was raining, they walked there. When they arrived, the restaurant was full. "Perhaps we can come back tomorrow," said Lisa. "Yeah, but it will probably be full again," said Kevin. In the end, they went home and cooked dinner themselves. They thought it would not be very good, but actually it was great!
items.passageZh: Lisa 和 Kevin 想去河對岸那家新開的餐廳吃吃看。雖然在下雨，他們還是走路過去。到了以後，餐廳已經客滿了。Lisa 說：「也許我們明天可以再來。」Kevin 說：「對啊，不過明天大概又會客滿。」最後他們回家自己煮晚餐。他們原本以為不會太好吃，沒想到其實非常好吃！

questions.questionZh: 他們到了餐廳，發生了什麼事？
最後他們的晚餐怎麼解決？

items.promptZh: 雖然這件外套很貴，我還是買了。
referenceEn: Although this coat was expensive, I still bought it.
I bought this jacket although it was expensive.
rubricZh: 用 although 表示「雖然」，後面接完整句子（主詞＋動詞）
although 和 but 不放在同一句（不寫 Although…, but…）

items.instructionZh: 用 probably 造一個句子，說說你明天大概會做的事。
referenceEn: I will probably go to bed early tomorrow.
Tomorrow I will probably eat lunch with my friends.
rubricZh: probably 表示「大概、很可能」，放在句中合理的位置（例如 will probably go、I'm probably going to…）
說明天的事用表示未來的寫法（例如 will、be going to）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：末句 "Actually, the food was very good!" 前文沒有鋪陳「原本以為自己煮會不好吃」的預期，actually 缺少對比對象，邏輯承接偏弱；可補一句如 "They thought it would not be very good." 或改 "And the food was very good!"。
